tests.reason: Untestable (no way): WezTerm 20240203-110809-5046fc22 on macOS records each OSC 133 mark but exposes neither it nor a command-exit status, so it cannot observe 133 D or the complete A/C/D cycle. No surface reads them back on default launch: mux/src/lib.rs has zero "semantic", the CLI's 19 verbs (CliSubCommand, wezterm/src/cli/mod.rs:77-166) read no zones, wezterm/src/cli/get_text.rs:34,86-87 prints text or escapes only, and the macOS frontend (window/src/os/macos, eight .rs files) names no semantic state. The upstream Linux row records the same empty arm at performer.rs:904-906 (e2a98e1b8af1); this arm is shared core term code, not a frontend path.
